edges: The CDC warned consumers not to eat Blue Bell-branded products made at the Broken Arrow plant.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: At least four individuals who developed listeriosis had consumed milkshakes made with Blue Bell ice cream.
Listeriosis is a serious infection caused by eating food contaminated with listeria.
